user.title: Connect to a Protege WX controller
user.description: Uses the controller's built-in web interface, so no Automation & Integration licence is needed. Use a dedicated operator with only the permissions Home Assistant needs.

data_description.host: IP address and port of the controller's web interface, for example 192.168.1.10:7377. Leave out http://.
data_description.username: The operator name you log in to the web interface with.
data_description.password: The password is never sent to the controller; only a challenge response is.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the controller again
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} rejected the saved login. Home Assistant has stopped trying so the operator isn't locked out.

data_description.host: IP address and port of the controller's web interface. Leave out http://.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach a Protege WX web interface at that address. Check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The controller rejected the username or password. Repeated failures lock the operator out for a while.
error.locked_out: The operator is locked out for {seconds} seconds after too many failed logins. Wait, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.wrong_controller: That address belongs to a different controller.

data.notify_failed_arm: Notify when the alarm fails to arm

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read area and zone status and the event log. 1 second is quick and light; doors and troubles are read at least every 5 seconds.
data_description.show_arming: Leave off for Apple Home. While off, the alarm shows the mode being armed (Home, Away or Night) as soon as the exit delay starts. The HomeKit Bridge shows every "Arming" state as Away.
data_description.notify_failed_arm: Shows a notification naming the zones that stopped the alarm arming, from Home Assistant or a keypad.
data_description.code_arm_required: Only applies once you add users. Disarming always needs a PIN when users exist.
data_description.outputs: Only outputs you pick are added. Leave out keypad LEDs, beepers, the bell and door locks.
data_description.visitor_minutes: How long a door's "Visitor unlock" button (and the protege_wx.visitor_unlock action, unless it says otherwise) holds the door unlocked before locking it again.

inputs.title: Input types
inputs.description: Pick what each input is, so it shows correctly in Home Assistant and Apple Home.

users.title: Users and PINs
users.description: People who can arm and disarm from Home Assistant with a PIN, for keypad cards and wall tablets. These are separate from the controller's own keypad users. Current users: {users}

data_description.code: At least 4 digits. Only a salted hash is stored.

areas.title: Alarm areas
areas.description:
**Night arms as** picks what Home Assistant's Night mode does on the controller: an instant arm (no entry delay), a stay arm (perimeter only, like Home), or nothing (Night is hidden).

The exit and entry delays drive the countdown sensor and the alarm card. They're read from the controller where it reports them; set them here to match your programming if they're wrong.

alarmo.title: Alarmo sync
alarmo.description:
Keep an Alarmo alarm in step with a Protege area, both ways: arm or disarm either one and the other follows. The controller has the final say: if it refuses to arm (a zone is open), Alarmo is disarmed again.

Leave the alarm empty to turn the sync off. Alarmo code saved: {code_set}.

data_description.alarmo_code: Only needed if Alarmo asks for a code to arm or disarm from automations. Leave blank to keep the saved one.

error.code_in_use: Another user already has that PIN.
error.name_in_use: There's already a user with that name.

abort.not_loaded: The integration has to be running to change these options.
abort.no_areas: This controller has no areas with zones.

failed_to_arm.message: {area} didn't arm because these zones were open: {zones}. Close them or use force arm.

force_stay_unsupported.message: The controller can't force arm in stay mode. Use away or instant.

auth_failed.message: The controller rejected the saved login. Log in again from the integration's page.

failed_to_arm_unknown.message: {area} didn't arm. The controller refused it; check for open zones or troubles, or use force arm.

arm_unconfirmed.message: Couldn't confirm that {area} armed, because the controller stopped answering. Check the keypad.

pin_locked_out.message: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {minutes} minutes.

bypass_while_armed.message: Bypassing a zone while its area is armed needs a PIN. Use the Bypass zone action with a PIN, or disarm first.

night_off.message: Night mode is turned off for this area. Pick what Night arms as in the integration's options (Alarm areas).

stay_off.message: Stay arming is turned off for this area on the controller.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm an area in a mode, optionally forcing it (bypassing open zones until disarmed).

force.name: Force
force.description: Bypass open zones until disarmed. Not available for stay.

code.name: PIN
code.description: Needed if users are set up and arming needs a PIN.

unlock_door.name: Unlock door
unlock_door.description: Unlock a door for its programmed time, or hold it open until locked.

hold_open.name: Hold open
hold_open.description: Keep the door unlocked until it's locked again.

bypass.name: Bypass zone
bypass.description: Bypass an input until disarmed, permanently, or remove the bypass.

code.name: PIN
code.description: Needed when users are set up and the zone's area is armed.

pulse_output.name: Pulse output
pulse_output.description: Turn an output on for a number of seconds; the controller turns it off.

visitor_unlock.name: Visitor unlock
visitor_unlock.description: Hold a door unlocked for a set time, then lock it again. Locking the door sooner cancels it.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to keep it unlocked. Leave out to use the time set in the integration's options (15 minutes unless changed).

controller_unreachable.title: Protege WX controller is unreachable
controller_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach the controller at {host} for {minutes} minutes, so alarm, door and zone states are out of date.

Check that the controller is powered and on the network, and that you can open its web interface in a browser. This alert clears by itself once the controller answers again.

low_supply_voltage.title: Protege WX supply voltage is low
low_supply_voltage.description:
The controller's supply has been below {threshold} V for more than 5 minutes (it's now {volts} V; a healthy supply is about 13.5 V).

This usually means a mains failure with the backup battery running down, or a failing battery or power supply. Get the alarm serviced soon: when the battery goes flat the alarm stops working. This alert clears by itself once the supply is back above 12.5 V.

event_log_unreadable.title: Protege WX can't read the event log
event_log_unreadable.description:
The operator {operator} hasn't been able to read the controller's event log for 5 minutes. Without it, Home Assistant can't show who armed, disarmed or opened a door, and can't tell you why the alarm didn't arm.

In the Protege web interface, open the operator's role and allow it to view events (the event log / review permission), then wait a minute. This alert clears by itself once the log can be read.

clock_drift.title: Protege WX clock is {minutes} minutes out
clock_drift.description:
The controller's clock is about {minutes} minutes {direction} Home Assistant's. Event times in the logbook, the controller's own event log and any time-based programming (schedules, auto-arming) will be off by the same amount.

Set the time in the Protege web interface (System > Date and Time) or turn on its time server (NTP) setting. This alert clears by itself once the clocks agree.

emergency.title: Protege WX {kind} alarm

confirm.title: Mark the {kind} alarm as handled
confirm.description: This only clears the alert in Home Assistant. It doesn't change anything on the controller.
